facts.value: Erasmus+ DELTA is an opportunity to engage with the existing Erasmus+ mobility programme for all staff who teach in Irish higher education. Staff undertaking training in the development of pedagogical and curriculum design skills can apply for a DELTA Scholarship.

facts.value: Erasmus+ DELTA focuses on supporting the professional development of all staff who teach in Irish higher education, with a particular focus on the enhancement of teaching and learning within and between disciplines.
